correctness.rationale: For each Poisson tumble count n, conditional Dirichlet spacings yield exact second and fourth moments; resumming gives Var=2m2(x−1+e^{−x})/γ² and κ4=12m2²(R A(x)+B(x))/γ⁴. A is a strict positive expected sum of fourth run lengths. Deriving F=−e^{3x}(BA′−B′A) gives c0..c7=0, c8=112 and a positive coefficient recurrence for all n≥8; hence R*(x)=−B/A strictly decreases 3 to 2. Dimension-five boundary comes from R=3d/(d+2) for constant speed. Independent symbolic identities and 48 Poisson–Dirichlet moment grids at finite x corroborate exact expressions; the infinite sign follows from analytic induction, not grids.
